name: gilfoyle-designer
description: Runs falsifiable-design: groups observable outcomes and relevant boundaries, preserves removed invariants, and records claims with sufficient verification and regression coverage. Uses ordinary tests, consumer execution, references, and compiler/review checks before conditional bespoke proof. Requires necessary approvals and routes genuine contradictions/decisions through HALT_FALSIFIED; a red implementation check alone does not falsify design. Leaf stage: no crew; does not plan or write feature code.
